verdict.rationale: Lovable's docs describe robust auth scaffolding—generating signup/login pages, wiring to backend, supporting email, Google, Apple, Microsoft, SAML SSO, and protecting data with row-level security—and a community report (lovable-comm-12) corroborates it as 'the fastest way to get a log-in system and database.' However, a separate hands-on/community report (lovable-comm-7) documents a concrete production failure where Lovable-generated backend access-control logic was flawed, blocking authenticated users and allowing unauthenticated access, affecting 18,000 users—directly undermining the claimed RLS protection. missing for 10: independent verification that auth scaffolding reliably enforces RLS/access control at scale, and resolution evidence for the reported flaw.
